name: Pete Tag
summary:
Pete Tag is a fast-paced, social VR experience inspired by Gorilla Tag, built for players who love movement, customization, and hanging out with friends. Swing, climb, and run your way through a wide variety of unique maps, each designed for fun exploration, competitive play, and casual chilling.
